# Native and converted mappings compared

Generated by `tests/test_retail.py` (`UPDATE_RETAIL=1 pytest tests/test_retail.py`).
See [docs/COMPARISON.md](../../../../docs/COMPARISON.md) for the discussion.

## TARQL

Native: [`tarql/`](../tarql). From OTTR: [`tarql-from-ottr/`](tarql-from-ottr).

### customers

| | native | from OTTR |
|---|---:|---:|
| CONSTRUCT triple patterns | 25 | 25 |
|   with a variable predicate | 0 | 13 |
| BINDs | 12 | 22 |
|   guards (`?_gN`) | 0 | 12 |
|   defaults (`COALESCE`) | 0 | 0 |
| lines (serialised, no comments) | 50 | 68 |

## OTTR

Native: [`ottr/`](../ottr). From TARQL: [`ottr-from-tarql/`](ottr-from-tarql).
Round trip (OTTR → TARQL → OTTR): [`ottr-round-trip/`](ottr-round-trip).

| | native | from TARQL | round trip |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| templates (not counting roots) | 13 | 11 | 13 |
|   used by more than one root | 4 | 1 | 0 |
| instances in template bodies | 65 | 66 | 71 |
| nesting depth (root to `ottr:Triple`) | 4 | 2 | 3 |
| parameters | 68 | 64 | 65 |
|   datatype (`xsd:decimal`, …) | 19 | 18 | 21 |
|   IRI (`ottr:IRI`, `owl:Class`, …) | 30 | 31 | 28 |
|   `xsd:string` | 10 | 14 | 16 |
|   untyped | 9 | 1 | 0 |
|   mandatory | 30 | 11 | 22 |
|   non-blank (`!`) | 10 | 0 | 0 |
|   with a default | 1 | 0 | 0 |
